descriptions.accordion: Collapsible sections with animated chevron; single or multiple open.
descriptions.alert: Inline status message (info, success, warning, danger).
descriptions.alert-dialog: Confirm/cancel modal for destructive or blocking decisions.
descriptions.app-bar: Top bar with title, back button and actions; takes a safe-area topInset.
descriptions.avatar: Image or initials avatar in a hard-shadowed frame.
descriptions.bottom-nav: Bottom tab bar with a sliding block, badges and a safe-area bottomInset.
descriptions.brutal-surface: The surface primitive: border, hard offset shadow and press physics. Everything blocky is built on it.
descriptions.button: Pressable button with variants, sizes, loading state and press physics.
descriptions.card: Bordered container with header/footer slots and CardText, which takes the variant's foreground colour; pressable when given onPress.
descriptions.carousel: Snapping horizontal carousel with pagination dots.
descriptions.date-picker: Date field that opens a calendar sheet.
descriptions.dialog: Compound modal dialog (Trigger, Content, Title, Description, Footer).
descriptions.drawer: Side drawer with swipe-to-close, scrim and Android back handling.
descriptions.dropdown-menu: Anchored menu that opens from a trigger.
descriptions.input: Text input with label, helper/error text and adornments.
descriptions.label: Form label.
descriptions.list-item: Pressable list row with leading/trailing slots.
descriptions.search-bar: Search input with clear and cancel controls.
descriptions.select: Select field that opens an options sheet.
descriptions.tabs: Tabs with a list of triggers and content panels.
descriptions.toast: Transient notification (controlled). Use Toaster/useToast for the one-line toast() API.
descriptions.toaster: Toaster provider and useToast(): toast('Saved'), toast.success(), toast.error(); queues one at a time.
descriptions.colors: Design tokens: colors (light/dark), spacing, typography, border widths, shadow offsets, motion. Edit this file to restyle every component.
descriptions.theme: ApexRNProvider and useTheme (light/dark/system). Installs the tokens too.
descriptions.metrics: Screen-size scaling helpers used by the tokens.
descriptions.icons: Small SVG icon set used by AppBar, Chip and SearchBar.
descriptions.use-press-physics: Spring + haptic press animation hook used by pressable surfaces.
